Write tests for InkOS Messages v1 rebuild. Working dir: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

## Context
Just-shipped rebuild: 3-pane omnichannel inbox + slide-in context pane + auto-triage + auto-reply engine + smart reply chips + composer power features (templates `/`, internal notes, schedule send, channel switcher) + `/settings/messaging` admin surface.

Plan: `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/lets-build-whole-page-tender-petal.md`
Project guide: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md`

Existing test infra: Vitest (unit/integration) + Playwright (e2e). Check `vitest.config.ts` + `playwright.config.ts` + existing `__tests__/` and `e2e/` dirs for conventions. Load `~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-lessons.md`.

## Files under test

### Backend
- `lib/messaging/triage.ts` — `triageConversation`, `generateSmartReplies`, `fireAutoReplyIfMatched`
- `lib/messaging/queries.ts` — `getChannelUnreadCounts`, `getConversationContext`, `listMessageTemplates`, `listAutoReplyRules`
- `lib/messaging/mutations.ts` — `setTriageTag`, `resolveConversation`, `toggleInternalNote`, template + rule CRUD, `scheduleMessage`
- `lib/messaging/send.ts` — `sendInternalNote` (does not call provider)
- `lib/messaging/templates-seed.ts` — `seedDefaultTemplates` idempotency
- `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts` — server actions Zod validation + auth guard + return contract
- `app/api/webhooks/twilio/route.ts` — post-ingest triage + auto-reply firing
- `app/api/webhooks/instagram/route.ts` + `whatsapp/route.ts` + `webchat/route.ts` — HMAC verification + subscription challenge
- `workers/jobs/send-scheduled-message.ts` — scheduled dispatch worker

### Frontend
- `components/messages/TriageTagPill.tsx`
- `components/messages/ChannelIcon.tsx`
- `components/messages/ChannelRail.tsx` — active state, unread badge, disconnected → ConnectChannelSheet
- `components/messages/ConversationListItem.tsx` — unread bg, active border, triage pill render
- `components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx` — inbound/outbound/auto-reply/internal-note variants
- `components/messages/Composer.tsx` — `/` trigger, internal-note mode, schedule send, channel switcher, ⌘+Enter
- `components/messages/ContextPane.tsx` — section rendering, quick action fires
- `components/messages/SmartReplyChips.tsx` — chip click fires action
- `hooks/messages/use-messages-shortcuts.ts` — j/k/r/a/e/!/n/?/Esc bindings
- `hooks/messages/use-conversation-presence.ts` — throttled typing, excludes current user

## Test scope — WRITE

### Unit (vitest, `__tests__/messaging/`)

1. **`triage.spec.ts`** — pure function rule engine
   - Inquiry when no client_id
   - Rescheduling keyword match wins over generic booking
   - Pricing keyword match
   - Booking when upcoming booking within 7 days exists
   - Client (default) when no rules match
   - Case-insensitivity on keywords
   - `generateSmartReplies` returns chips for each triage tag path
   - Smart replies include valid SmartReplyAction kinds only
   - Max 4 chips returned
   Mock supabase client + RPC response.

2. **`auto-reply.spec.ts`** — `fireAutoReplyIfMatched`
   - Fires when new_inquiry rule matches + cooldown elapsed
   - Skips when cooldown not elapsed (last_auto_reply_at within cooldown window)
   - Matches keyword rule over new_inquiry rule by priority order
   - Returns fired=false on no matching rule
   - Enqueues send-sms BullMQ job with comm id on fire
   - Respects template rendering variables

3. **`templates-seed.spec.ts`**
   - Inserts 6 default templates on first call
   - Idempotent: second call inserts zero new rows (UNIQUE constraint)
   - Returns count of inserted rows

4. **`composer.spec.ts`** — component test via @testing-library/react
   - Type `/` at empty line-start → TemplatePopover opens
   - Select a template → textarea body replaced
   - Toggle internal-note → bg class changes, Send label becomes "Save note"
   - Schedule send popover → submit with future date → action fires with scheduledFor
   - Channel switcher defaults to conversation channel
   - ⌘+Enter submits
   - Empty body disables Send

5. **`triage-tag-pill.spec.ts`** — each tag renders correct label + class (spot-check brand classes present, no indigo/amber)

6. **`actions.spec.ts`** — `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts`
   - Every action requires auth (mock no session → returns `{ ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }`)
   - Zod rejects bad input with specific error message
   - Happy path returns `{ ok: true, data }`

7. **`webhook-hmac.spec.ts`** — IG/WA/WebChat stubs
   - GET subscription challenge returns challenge when verify_token matches
   - GET returns 403 when verify_token mismatches
   - POST returns 403 on HMAC mismatch
   - POST returns 200 on valid HMAC
   - All routes rate-limited (mock ratelimit → 429 when limit hit)

8. **`scheduled-worker.spec.ts`** — `workers/jobs/send-scheduled-message.ts`
   - Dispatches SMS via Twilio when channel=sms
   - Dispatches Email via Resend when channel=email
   - Updates comm status to 'sent' + sent_at on success
   - Updates status to 'failed' + error on provider error
   - Retries exponentially on transient failure

### E2E (Playwright, `e2e/`)

9. **`messages-omnichannel.spec.ts`** — full flow
   - Login → navigate to `/messages`
   - Verify 3-pane grid renders on desktop viewport (1440x900)
   - Click SMS channel rail → URL updates with `?channel=sms` → list filters
   - Click an existing conversation → `?c=<id>` in URL + thread loads
   - Click Info button → context pane slides in
   - Click Info again → pane closes
   - Open composer → type "/" → TemplatePopover opens
   - Select "Deposit request" template → body inserted
   - Clear + type "Hey" → Send button enabled → click Send → bubble appears (mock provider)
   - Toggle internal note → composer bg changes → type "client runs late" → Send → internal-note bubble renders with "Staff only" label
   - Click `?` or press `?` → cheatsheet dialog opens
   - Press `j` then `k` → conversation selection moves

10. **`settings-messaging.spec.ts`**
    - Login → navigate to `/settings/messaging`
    - Feature gate passes on Studio+ plan (mock)
    - Click "+ Add rule" → RuleEditorSheet opens
    - Fill trigger=new_inquiry, template=Inquiry auto-reply, cooldown=60 → Save → rule appears in list
    - Toggle rule → state persists
    - Click "+ New template" → TemplateEditorSheet → fill form → Save → template appears in table
    - Click "Restore defaults" → 6 templates appear
    - Category filter pills filter table

### Fixtures
Create `__tests__/messaging/fixtures.ts` with:
- `mockStudio`, `mockClient`, `mockConversation`, `mockMessage`, `mockTemplate`, `mockRule` factories
- Mock supabase client helper (reuse existing pattern from other tests if present)

### Mocking Realtime + webhooks
Mock Supabase Realtime channels (presence) — existing tests may show pattern. Mock Twilio + Resend clients (return ok). Mock BullMQ `add()` with spy.

## Non-negotiable
- No `any`
- No `console.log` 
- Every test has explicit `expect` assertion
- Each describe has `beforeEach` cleanup where needed
- E2E uses Playwright's `page` API + `getByRole` / `getByLabel` accessibility selectors (not `getByTestId`)
- Unit tests under 200ms each
- Brand-compliance assertions: in `composer.spec.ts` + `triage-tag-pill.spec.ts` assert no class contains 'indigo'|'amber'|'green-'|'pink-'|'yellow'

## Verification
```bash
pnpm test messaging           # unit tests should all pass
pnpm test:e2e --grep messages # e2e
```

If `pnpm test:e2e` can't run in this env (playwright browsers, dev server), write the spec anyway — it runs in CI.

## Deliverables
1. Test files listed above
2. `pnpm test messaging` passes green (at minimum for unit tests)
3. Report back: files created, test count, pass/fail, any blockers

Under 800 tokens report back. Execute immediately.

222	    }
223

316	  } catch (err) {
317	    logger.error({ err, conversationId, studioId }, 'auto-reply: unexpected error in fireAutoReplyIfMatched')

319	  }

116	  const limit = filters.limit ?? 50
117	  const offset = filters.offset ?? 0
118	
119	  let query = supabase
120	    .from('conversations')
121	    .select(
122	      `
123	      *,
124	      client:clients (
125	        id, first_name, last_name, email, phone,
126	        total_spent_cents, total_sessions, no_show_count, tags
127	      )
128	    `,
129	      { count: 'exact' },
130	    )
131	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
132	    .order('last_message_at', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
133	    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1)
134	
135	  // Archived / active filter
136	  if (filters.archived === true) {
137	    query = query.not('archived_at', 'is', null)
138	  } else {
139	    query = query.is('archived_at', null)
140	  }
141	
142	  if (filters.channel) {
143	    query = query.eq('channel', filters.channel)
144	  }
145	
146	  if (filters.unreadOnly) {
147	    query = query.gt('unread_count', 0)
148	  }
149	
150	  if (filters.triageTag) {
151	    query = query.eq('triage_tag', filters.triageTag)
152	  }
153	
154	  if (filters.starred === true) {
155	    query = query.eq('starred', true)
156	  }
157

9	 * Note: uses service-role client because this is a webhook (no session cookie).
10	 * Studio routing: match To number against studios.twilio_phone_number column.
11	 * If that column doesn't exist yet, falls back to TWILIO_FALLBACK_STUDIO_ID env var.
12	 */
13	
14	import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
15	import { createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
16	import { verifyTwilioSignature } from '@/lib/sms/twilio'
17	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
18	import { triageConversation, fireAutoReplyIfMatched } from '@/lib/messaging/triage'
19	
20	// Twilio status → our status mapping
21	const STATUS_MAP: Record<string, 'queued' | 'sent' | 'delivered' | 'failed'> = {
22	  queued: 'queued',
23	  sending: 'queued',
24	  sent: 'sent',
25	  delivered: 'delivered',
26	  undelivered: 'failed',
27	  failed: 'failed',
28	  read: 'delivered',
29	}

31	// ─── POST /api/webhooks/twilio ────────────────────────────────────────────────
32	
33	export async function POST(request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
34	  // Twilio sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded
35	  let params: Record<string, string>
36	  try {
37	    const text = await request.text()
38	    params = Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(text))
39	  } catch (err) {
40	    logger.error({ err }, 'twilio-webhook: failed to parse body')
41	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Bad request' }, { status: 400 })
42	  }
43	
44	  // ── Signature verification ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
45	  const authToken = process.env.TWILIO_WEBHOOK_AUTH_TOKEN ?? process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
46	
47	  if (!authToken) {
48	    logger.error({}, 'twilio-webhook: TWILIO_WEBHOOK_AUTH_TOKEN not set — rejecting request')
49	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Webhook not configured' }, { status: 200 })
50	  }
51	
52	  const signature = request.headers.get('x-twilio-signature') ?? ''
53	  // Use the full URL for signature verification
54	  const webhookUrl =
55	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
56	      ? `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/api/webhooks/twilio`
57	      : `https://${request.headers.get('host') ?? 'localhost'}/api/webhooks/twilio`
58	
59	  const isValid = verifyTwilioSignature(webhookUrl, params, signature, authToken)
60

60	
61	  if (!isValid) {
62	    logger.warn({ signature: '[REDACTED]' }, 'twilio-webhook: invalid signature — rejecting')
63	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, { status: 403 })
64	  }
65	
66	  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
67	
68	  const messageSid = params['MessageSid'] ?? ''
69	  const messageStatus = params['MessageStatus'] ?? ''
70	  const from = params['From'] ?? ''
71	  const to = params['To'] ?? ''
72	  const body = params['Body'] ?? ''
73	
74	  // Determine if this is an inbound message or a status callback
75	  const isStatusCallback = Boolean(messageSid && messageStatus && !body && !from)
76	  const isInbound = Boolean(from && body && !messageStatus)
77	
78	  // ── Case 1: Delivery status update ─────────────────────────────────────────
79	  if (isStatusCallback || (messageSid && messageStatus)) {
80	    await handleStatusUpdate(supabase, messageSid, messageStatus, params)
81	    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 200 })
82	  }
83	
84	  // ── Case 2: Inbound message ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
85	  if (isInbound) {
86	    await handleInboundSms(supabase, { from, to, body, messageSid, params })
87	    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 200 })
88	  }
89	
90	  logger.warn({ params: { MessageSid: messageSid, MessageStatus: messageStatus } }, 'twilio-webhook: unrecognised payload shape')
91	  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 200 })
92	}

94	// ─── handleStatusUpdate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
95	
96	async function handleStatusUpdate(
97	  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createServiceRoleClient>,
98	  messageSid: string,
99	  messageStatus: string,
100	  _params: Record<string, string>,
101	): Promise<void> {
102	  if (!messageSid) return
103	
104	  const mappedStatus = STATUS_MAP[messageStatus] ?? 'sent'
105	
106	  const { error } = await supabase
107	    .from('client_communications')
108	    .update({
109	      status: mappedStatus,
110	      ...(messageStatus === 'delivered' && { delivered_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
111	    })
112	    .eq('provider_message_id', messageSid)
113	
114	  if (error) {
115	    logger.error({ err: error, messageSid, messageStatus }, 'twilio-webhook: status update failed')
116	  } else {
117	    logger.info({ messageSid, mappedStatus }, 'twilio-webhook: status updated')
118	  }
119	}

1	/**
2	 * send-scheduled-message BullMQ worker.
3	 *
4	 * Consumes 'send-scheduled-message' jobs from the inkos-jobs queue.
5	 * Job payload: { commId: string; studioId: string }
6	 *   commId   — client_communications.id with status='queued' + scheduled_for set
7	 *   studioId — logging context + studio phone number lookup
8	 *
9	 * Dispatches via:
10	 *   - channel='sms'   → Twilio
11	 *   - channel='email' → Resend
12	 *
13	 * Retry strategy: 3 attempts, exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 25s).
14	 * Idempotent: skips rows already in a terminal state (sent/delivered/failed).
15	 */
16	
17	import { Worker } from 'bullmq'
18	import { Twilio } from 'twilio'
19	import { Resend } from 'resend'
20	import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase'
21	import { logger } from '../lib/logger'
22	import { workerEnv } from '../lib/env'
23	
24	const QUEUE_NAME = 'inkos-jobs'
25	const JOB_NAME = 'send-scheduled-message'
26	
27	// ─── Payload type ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
28	
29	interface SendScheduledMessagePayload {
30	  commId: string
31	  studioId: string
32	}
33	
34	function isValidPayload(data: unknown): data is SendScheduledMessagePayload {
35	  return (
36	    typeof data === 'object' &&
37	    data !== null &&
38	    typeof (data as Record<string, unknown>)['commId'] === 'string' &&
39	    typeof (data as Record<string, unknown>)['studioId'] === 'string'
40	  )
41	}
42	
43	// ─── Twilio client (lazy) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
44	
45	let _twilio: Twilio | null = null
46	
47	function getTwilioClient(): Twilio | null {
48	  if (!workerEnv.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID || !workerEnv.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN) return null
49	  if (!_twilio) {
50	    _twilio = new Twilio(workerEnv.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, workerEnv.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)
51	  }
52	  return _twilio
53	}
54	
55	// ─── Resend client (lazy) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
56	
57	let _resend: Resend | null = null
58	
59	function getResendClient(): Resend | null {
60	  if (!workerEnv.RESEND_API_KEY) return null
61	  if (!_resend) {
62	    _resend = new Resend(workerEnv.RESEND_API_KEY)
63	  }
64	  return _resend
65	}
66	
67	// ─── Worker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
68	
69	export function createSendScheduledMessageWorker() {
70	  const worker = new Worker(
71	    QUEUE_NAME,
72	    async (job) => {
73	      if (job.name !== JOB_NAME) return
74	
75	      if (!isValidPayload(job.data)) {
76	        logger.error({ jobId: job.id, data: job.data }, 'send-scheduled-message: invalid payload — skipping')
77	        return
78	      }
79	
80	      const { commId, studioId } = job.data
81	      const workerLog = logger.child({ jobId: job.id, commId, studioId })
82	      workerLog.info('send-scheduled-message: processing')
83	
84	      // ── 1. Fetch comm row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
85	      const { data: comm, error: commErr } = await supabase
86	        .from('client_communications')
87	        .select('id, status, body, subject, client_id, studio_id, channel, scheduled_for, is_internal_note')
88	        .eq('id', commId)
89	        .single()
90	
91	      if (commErr || !comm) {
92	        workerLog.error({ err: commErr }, 'send-scheduled-message: comm row not found')
93	        throw new Error(`comm row not found: ${commId}`)
94	      }
95	
96	      // Internal notes are never dispatched
97	      if (comm.is_internal_note) {
98	        workerLog.info('send-scheduled-message: comm is internal note — skipping dispatch')
99	        return
100	      }
101	
102	      // ── 2. Idempotency guard ──────────────────────────────────────────────
103	      const terminalStatuses = ['sent', 'delivered', 'failed', 'bounced'] as const
104	      if (terminalStatuses.includes(comm.status as typeof terminalStatuses[number])) {
105	        workerLog.info({ status: comm.status }, 'send-scheduled-message: already terminal — skipping')
106	        return
107	      }
108	
109	      // ── 3. Defensive: check scheduled_for <= now() ────────────────────────
110	      if (comm.scheduled_for) {
111	        const scheduledAt = new Date(comm.scheduled_for).getTime()
112	        if (scheduledAt > Date.now() + 5_000) {
113	          // More than 5s in the future — re-queue with remaining delay
114	          const remainingMs = scheduledAt - Date.now()
115	          workerLog.warn({ scheduledFor: comm.scheduled_for, remainingMs }, 'send-scheduled-message: too early — re-queuing')
116	          throw new Error(`Scheduled time not reached yet (${remainingMs}ms remaining)`)
117	        }
118	      }
119	
120	      // ── 4. Dispatch by channel ────────────────────────────────────────────
121	      if (comm.channel === 'sms') {
122	        await dispatchSms(comm, studioId, workerLog)
123	      } else if (comm.channel === 'email') {
124	        await dispatchEmail(comm, studioId, workerLog)
125	      } else {
126	        workerLog.warn({ channel: comm.channel }, 'send-scheduled-message: unsupported channel — skipping')
127	        await supabase
128	          .from('client_communications')
129	          .update({ status: 'failed', error: `Unsupported channel: ${comm.channel}`, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
130	          .eq('id', commId)
131	      }
132	    },
133	    {
134	      connection: {
135	        url: workerEnv.REDIS_URL,
136	        maxRetriesPerRequest: null,
137	      },
138	      concurrency: 5,
139	      // 3 attempts: 1s → 5s → 25s (exponential, base 1000ms)
140	    },
141	  )
142	
143	  worker.on('completed', (job) => {
144	    logger.info({ jobId: job.id }, 'send-scheduled-message: completed')
145	  })
146	
147	  worker.on('failed', (job, err) => {
148	    logger.error({ jobId: job?.id, err }, 'send-scheduled-message: failed')
149	  })
150	
151	  worker.on('error', (err) => {
152	    logger.error({ err }, 'send-scheduled-message: worker error')
153	  })
154	
155	  return worker
156	}
157	
158	// ─── dispatchSms ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
159	
160	async function dispatchSms(
161	  comm: { id: string; body: string; client_id: string; studio_id: string },
162	  studioId: string,
163	  workerLog: ReturnType<typeof logger.child>,
164	): Promise<void> {
165	  const twilioClient = getTwilioClient()
166	  if (!twilioClient) {
167	    workerLog.warn('send-scheduled-message: Twilio not configured — marking failed')
168	    await supabase
169	      .from('client_communications')
170	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: 'Twilio not configured', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
171	      .eq('id', comm.id)
172	    return
173	  }
174	
175	  // Resolve client phone
176	  const { data: client, error: clientErr } = await supabase
177	    .from('clients')
178	    .select('phone')
179	    .eq('id', comm.client_id)
180	    .single()
181	
182	  if (clientErr || !client?.phone) {
183	    workerLog.warn('send-scheduled-message: client has no phone — marking failed')
184	    await supabase
185	      .from('client_communications')
186	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: 'Client has no phone number', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
187	      .eq('id', comm.id)
188	    return
189	  }
190	
191	  // Resolve studio From number
192	  const { data: studio } = await supabase
193	    .from('studios')
194	    .select('twilio_phone_number')
195	    .eq('id', studioId)
196	    .single()
197	
198	  const fromNumber = studio?.twilio_phone_number ?? workerEnv.TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER
199	
200	  if (!fromNumber) {
201	    workerLog.error('send-scheduled-message: no From number available')
202	    await supabase
203	      .from('client_communications')
204	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: 'No Twilio From number configured', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
205	      .eq('id', comm.id)
206	    return
207	  }
208	
209	  try {
210	    const message = await twilioClient.messages.create({
211	      from: fromNumber,
212	      to: client.phone,
213	      body: comm.body,
214	    })
215	
216	    await supabase
217	      .from('client_communications')
218	      .update({
219	        status: 'sent',
220	        provider_message_id: message.sid,
221	        sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
222	        error: null,
223	        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
224	      })
225	      .eq('id', comm.id)
226	
227	    workerLog.info({ sid: message.sid }, 'send-scheduled-message: SMS sent')
228	  } catch (err: unknown) {
229	    const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
230	    workerLog.error({ err }, 'send-scheduled-message: Twilio send failed')
231	    await supabase
232	      .from('client_communications')
233	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: errMsg, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
234	      .eq('id', comm.id)
235	    throw err
236	  }
237	}
238	
239	// ─── dispatchEmail ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
240	
241	async function dispatchEmail(
242	  comm: { id: string; body: string; subject: string | null; client_id: string; studio_id: string },
243	  _studioId: string,
244	  workerLog: ReturnType<typeof logger.child>,
245	): Promise<void> {
246	  const resend = getResendClient()
247	  if (!resend) {
248	    workerLog.warn('send-scheduled-message: Resend not configured — marking failed')
249	    await supabase
250	      .from('client_communications')
251	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: 'Resend not configured', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
252	      .eq('id', comm.id)
253	    return
254	  }
255	
256	  // Resolve client email
257	  const { data: client, error: clientErr } = await supabase
258	    .from('clients')
259	    .select('email, first_name, last_name')
260	    .eq('id', comm.client_id)
261	    .single()
262	
263	  if (clientErr || !client?.email) {
264	    workerLog.warn('send-scheduled-message: client has no email — marking failed')
265	    await supabase
266	      .from('client_communications')
267	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: 'Client has no email address', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
268	      .eq('id', comm.id)
269	    return
270	  }
271	
272	  try {
273	    const { error: sendErr } = await resend.emails.send({
274	      from: workerEnv.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
275	      to: client.email,
276	      replyTo: workerEnv.RESEND_REPLY_TO,
277	      subject: comm.subject ?? '(no subject)',
278	      text: comm.body,
279	    })
280	
281	    if (sendErr) {
282	      throw new Error(sendErr.message)
283	    }
284	
285	    await supabase
286	      .from('client_communications')
287	      .update({
288	        status: 'sent',
289	        sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
290	        error: null,
291	        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
292	      })
293	      .eq('id', comm.id)
294	
295	    workerLog.info({ to: client.email }, 'send-scheduled-message: email sent')
296	  } catch (err: unknown) {
297	    const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
298	    workerLog.error({ err }, 'send-scheduled-message: Resend send failed')
299	    await supabase
300	      .from('client_communications')
301	      .update({ status: 'failed', error: errMsg, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
302	      .eq('id', comm.id)
303	    throw err
304	  }
305	}

2	 * Instagram / Meta Graph webhook handler.
3	 *
4	 * GET  — Meta subscription verification challenge.
5	 * POST — Inbound IG DM stub. Verifies X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256.
6	 *        Logs body + returns 200. No message ingest in v1.
7	 *
8	 * Activate when Meta App Review + PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN lands.
9	 * Feature gate: omnichannel_inbox (Studio+). Studio routing is v2 work

12	 */

14	import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
15	import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'
16	import { apiRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
17	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
18	
19	// ─── GET — Meta subscription verification ─────────────────────────────────────
20	
21	export async function GET(request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
22	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
23	  const mode = searchParams.get('hub.mode')
24	  const token = searchParams.get('hub.verify_token')
25	  const challenge = searchParams.get('hub.challenge')
26	
27	  if (mode === 'subscribe' && token === process.env.META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN) {
28	    logger.info({}, 'instagram-webhook: subscription verified')
29	    return new NextResponse(challenge ?? '', {
30	      status: 200,
31	      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' },
32	    })
33	  }
34	
35	  logger.warn({ mode, tokenMatch: token === process.env.META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN }, 'instagram-webhook: verification failed')
36	  return new NextResponse('Forbidden', { status: 403 })
37	}
38	
39	// ─── POST — Inbound IG DM ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
40	
41	export async function POST(request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
42	  // Rate-limit: apply to POST only (GET is low-volume challenge ping)
43	  const ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? 'unknown'
44	  const rl = await apiRatelimit.limit(ip)
45	  if (!rl.success) {
46	    return new NextResponse('Too many requests', { status: 429 })
47	  }
48	
49	  // Read raw body for HMAC verification
50	  let rawBody: string
51	  try {
52	    rawBody = await request.text()
53	  } catch {
54	    return new NextResponse('Bad request', { status: 400 })
55	  }
56	
57	  // Verify X-Hub-Signature-256
58	  const appSecret = process.env.META_APP_SECRET
59	  if (!appSecret) {
60	    logger.error({}, 'instagram-webhook: META_APP_SECRET not set — rejecting')
61	    return new NextResponse('Webhook not configured', { status: 200 })
62	  }
63	
64	  const signature = request.headers.get('x-hub-signature-256') ?? ''
65	  const signatureBuffer = Buffer.from(signature.replace('sha256=', ''), 'hex')
66	  const expectedBuffer = createHmac('sha256', appSecret)
67	    .update(rawBody)
68	    .digest()
69	
70	  const valid =
71	    signatureBuffer.length === expectedBuffer.length &&
72	    timingSafeEqual(signatureBuffer, expectedBuffer)
73	
74	  if (!valid) {
75	    logger.warn({}, 'instagram-webhook: invalid X-Hub-Signature-256 — rejecting')
76	    return new NextResponse('Forbidden', { status: 403 })
77	  }
78	
79	  // TODO(v2): parse payload, route by page_id → studio_id, ingest comm row,
80	  // call triageConversation + fireAutoReplyIfMatched.
81	  // Requires feature gate omnichannel_inbox check after studio routing resolves.
82	  logger.info({ bodyLength: rawBody.length }, 'instagram-webhook: received (stub — ingest v2)')
83	
84	  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 200 })
85	}
